description: This file defines the CognitoIdentityProvider class, which provides methods to interact with AWS Cognito Identity service, including managing identity pool IDs, logins, and credentials asynchronously using promises.

classes.name: CognitoIdentityProvider
classes.description: A class that provides methods to interact with AWS Cognito Identity service, including obtaining identity IDs and credentials, and updating login mappings.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the provider with identity pool ID, client options, logins, and optional account ID, setting up the AWS CognitoIdentityClient.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Asynchronous method using promises to obtain AWS credentials for the identity, fetching ID and credentials via the client.

methods.name: updateLogin
methods.description: Updates the logins array with a new key-value pair, allowing login mappings to be modified after instantiation.
